verdict.rationale: Superset has a broad programmatic surface. The CLI drives the same backend as the desktop app, and the TypeScript SDK, hosted MCP server and a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec cover workspaces, tasks, projects, automations, agents, terminals and hosts. Nothing documents full parity with the UI, and several UI features have no evidenced API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of diff review and stage/commit/push/Create PR, the Design browser-pane flow, PR line-comment feedback to agents, design/report sharing, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Superset CLI (`superset`) is a single static binary that drives the same backend as the desktop app.
The Superset TypeScript SDK lets you create and manage your workspaces, tasks, projects, and automations from code.
Superset MCP server: create Git-worktree workspaces, launch coding-agent sessions, schedule automations, open terminals, and manage tasks on behalf of a Superset user.
keyless GET of https://api.superset.sh/openapi.json returned the OpenAPI 3.1 spec — title 'Superset API', summary "Programmatic access to Superset's agent-orchestration platform"
